run_experiment: run a BenchMARL multi-agent reinforcement learning experiment with MAPPO algorithm on the VMAS balance task
configure_task_agents: configure a VMAS balance task to use a custom number of agents by overriding task config
load_algorithm_config: load a MAPPO algorithm configuration from the default YAML config file using MappoConfig
load_experiment_config: load an experiment configuration from the default YAML config file using ExperimentConfig
create_experiment: create an Experiment instance with a task, algorithm config, model config, and critic model config
